Unzip `IOT_2017_ixi.zip` from the EXIOBASE 3.11.2 Zenodo record (https://zenodo.org/records/23039074) here, so that
`external/IOT_2017_ixi/Z.txt` exists, or set the environment variable `EXIOBASE_DIR` to the unzipped folder.
EXIOBASE is not redistributed with this repository because of its licence.
